# Step 1: Get all scheduled transactions

    year: int

    f"Parse the following date string into year, month, and day: {current_date}",
    output_schema=DateParseModel
)

    next_month = 1
    next_year = dt.year + 1
else:
    next_month = dt.month + 1
    next_year = dt.year

# Format the new date as string (YYYY-MM-DD)

    id=rent_info.id,
    recipient=None,
    amount=None,
    subject=None,
    date=new_date_str,

)
